title: Get the TikTok Minis within an ad account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the list of TikTok Minis within an ad account. To learn more about the campaign type where you can promote a TikTok Mini, see [Create an Upgraded Smart+ TikTok Growth Max: Mini Games campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-upgraded-smart-mini-games-campaign/v1.3) and [Create an Upgraded Smart+ TikTok Growth Max: Mini Dramas campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-upgraded-smart-minis-campaign/v1.3). ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/minis/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID.| |page|number|Current page number.

Default value: 1. Value range: ≥ 1.| |page_size|number|Page size.

Default value: 10. Value range: 1-50.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/minis/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&page=1&page_size=50' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code|number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id|string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|list|object[]|A list of TikTok Minis within an ad account.| ##|minis_id|string|The ID of the TikTok Mini.| ##|minis_name|string|The name of the TikTok Mini.| ##|minis_icon_url|string|The URL to the app icon image of the TikTok Mini.| ##|minis_status|string|The status of the TikTok Mini.

Enum values:
  • `ACTIVE`: active. You can use the TikTok Mini to create ads.
  • `INACTIVE`: inactive. You cannot use the TikTok Mini to create ads.
| ##|minis_type|string|The type of the TikTok Mini.

Enum values:
  • `MINI_SERIES`: mini drama.
  • `MINI_GAME`: mini game.
| ##|region_codes|string[]|The region codes of the supported country or region for the TikTok Mini.

Example: `["ID", "US"]`.| #|page_info|object|Pagination information.| ##|page|number|Current page number.| ##|page_size|number|Paging size.| ##|total_number|number|Total number of results.| ##|total_page|number|Total pages of results.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "minis_icon_url": "{{minis_icon_url}}", "minis_id": "{{minis_id}}", "minis_name": "{{minis_name}}", "minis_status": "ACTIVE", "minis_type": "MINI_GAME", "region_codes": [ "JP", "US", "ID" ] }, { "minis_icon_url": "{{minis_icon_url}}", "minis_id": "{{minis_id}}", "minis_name": "{{minis_name}}", "minis_status": "ACTIVE", "minis_type": "MINI_GAME", "region_codes": [ "JP", "US", "ID" ] }, { "minis_icon_url": "{{minis_icon_url}}", "minis_id": "{{minis_id}}", "minis_name": "{{minis_name}}", "minis_status": "ACTIVE", "minis_type": "MINI_SERIES", "region_codes": [ "JP" ] }, { "minis_icon_url": "{{minis_icon_url}}", "minis_id": "{{minis_id_4}}", "minis_name": "{{minis_name_4}}", "minis_status": "ACTIVE", "minis_type": "MINI_SERIES", "region_codes": [ "US" ] } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 50, "total_number": 4, "total_page": 1 } } } (/code) ```
